newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - July 31.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - July 31.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following stories on its front page Thursday:
* Twin explosions were set off in a crowded Jerusalem market killing at least 13 people and the two bombers. Militant Islamic group Hamas took responsibility.
* Two Army investigations into the service's handling of sexual misconduct found widespread evidence of discrimination against women.
* A federal grand jury indicted three executives of Columbia/HCA Healthcare Corp on charges of defrauding the government.
* The House voted for legislation to balance the budget by 2002.

* The New York State budget agreement between Gov. George Pataki and state legislative leaders came under criticism from bond raters and fiscal monitors who said its deep multi-year tax cuts and spending increases were likely to create major financial problems for the state.
